# Akrostech

> Akrostech Consulting LLC gives U.S. businesses dedicated offshore professionals and a
> web studio based in India, working U.S. business hours (EST, CST, MST, PST). Services:
> website development, recruitment process outsourcing, virtual assistance, accounting
> outsourcing, and legal process outsourcing. Model: dedicated full-time/part-time
> resources, project-based work, and scalable teams — vetted for skill, English, and
> reliability, under NDAs with measured quality reporting.

## Services (in order)

- [Website Development](https://www.akrosstech.com/services/website-development): Marketing sites, web apps, e-commerce, CMS builds, redesigns, UI/UX, technical SEO, hosting, and monthly care plans. Fixed-scope projects or dedicated developers/designers.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing](https://www.akrosstech.com/services/recruitment-process-outsourcing): Full-cycle or modular recruiting — sourcing, screening, ATS management, interview scheduling, offer and onboarding support. Industries: IT, healthcare, BFSI, engineering/manufacturing, corporate/admin, sales/customer service.
- [Virtual Assistance](https://www.akrostech.com/services/virtual-assistance): Dedicated VAs for founders and teams — inbox and calendar, customer support (chat/email/phone), social media, content support, data entry/CRM hygiene, research, personal assistance.
- [Accounting Outsourcing](https://www.akrostech.com/services/accounting-outsourcing): Bookkeeping, AP/AR, invoicing, payroll, month-end close, reconciliations, 1099/sales-tax prep support alongside the client's CPA. Tools: QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books.
- [Legal Process Outsourcing](https://www.akrostech.com/services/legal-process-outsourcing): Paralegal support for U.S. law firms — intake, document prep, records retrieval, discovery support, calendaring, demand-letter drafting — under attorney supervision. Not a law firm; no legal advice.

- Differentiators: dedicated (not shared) professionals; U.S.-hours overlap; vetting for skill, English, reliability; NDAs and access controls; KPI reporting and reviews.
